contract.input: a symbol (upper-cased by the port) and namespace; the resolver passes 'TICKER' only
contract.output: AVAILABLE with candidates [{ticker, asset_class, sub_asset_class}] and provenance {table, key, read: GetItem} on a row; ABSENT for no row or a CUSIP-keyed row; UNAVAILABLE with reason_code REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE on any read error, a non-mapping Item, or a non-TICKER namespace
contract.effect_on_state: NONE. A registry AVAILABLE on a provider NOT_FOUND symbol adds the registry key and leaves state NOT_FOUND and reason EXACT_IDENTIFIER_ABSENT_IN_PROVIDER_READ. A FOUND symbol is never asked and never carries the key.
contract.writes: none: the only client method used is get_item; a spy refuses every other attribute (test_no_write_method_is_ever_called_on_the_client)
